title: Quick Indulgent Mexican Swede Burrito
description: A winey and shaggy Mexican dish featuring swede, glaze, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients in a burrito form, served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the taco seasoning and stir to combine.
Warm the low-glycemic tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the burritos by spooning the beef mixture onto the center of each tortilla and topping with diced swede.
Drizzle the red wine glaze over the top of each burrito.
Place the burritos on a wooden board and serve immediately.
